summary: Frontend-only verification of the one-time Terms of Use acceptance gate. Tested on public preview URL (https://etheria-divination.preview.emergentagent.com) on mobile viewport 390x844. Admin login (etheriasystems@gmail.com / $Tory2410, terms_accepted_at pre-reset to null by main agent) + math-captcha solver. ALL 10 verification points PASS: (1) Unauthenticated landing renders without redirect — / shows the Etheria landing page with Sign In / Sign Up. (2) After login, user is auto-redirected to /terms-acceptance. (3) Gate content fully verified — all 20 expected strings present including '✦ Welcome to Etheria ✦' eyebrow, 'Terms of Use' title, 'Please read carefully…' subtitle, all 12 numbered sections (Acceptance of Terms / About Etheria / Age Requirement / User Responsibilities / AI-Generated Content Disclaimer / Subscriptions & Payments / Community Conduct & Moderation / Privacy / Intellectual Property / Limitation of Liability / Changes to These Terms / Contact), 'Last updated: June 14, 2026 • Version 1.0' footer, initial 'Scroll to the bottom to enable acceptance' marker, 'I Accept' and 'Decline & Sign Out' buttons. (4) Pre-scroll tap of action-bar 'I Accept' is a no-op — zero network calls to /api/auth/accept-terms (button is disabled via React Native's `disabled` prop + opacity 0.5). (5) Scrolling the inner ScrollView to the bottom flips marker text to 'You have reviewed the full Terms of Use' with the yellow sparkle icon — verified on-screen. (6/7) Tapping action-bar 'I Accept' after scroll triggers POST /api/auth/accept-terms, then two GET /api/auth/me calls (refreshAuth + protected-layout effect), then router.replace('/') routes to home / which renders the menu with avatar, 'WELCOME BACK Etheria Dev', Premium badge, Monthly Prize Drawing, Today's Oracle, etc. (8) Browser reload from / stays on / — the gate does NOT re-fire, proving terms_accepted_at was persisted server-side. (9) Drawer menu opened: visible labels = Home, Meditation, Spirit Guides, Oracle Divination, Dream Interpreter, Astral Travel Self-Study, Psychic Training, Progress Journal, Community, Inbox, My Profile, Users, My Circle, Settings — 'Terms of Use' / 'terms-acceptance' is NOT a destination in the drawer (correctly hidden via drawerItemStyle: { display: 'none' }). (10) Logout (via localStorage session_token clear + navigate to /auth/login) and re-login lands directly on home / — the gate is skipped, proving one-time-only enforcement. (11) Decline flow NOT exercised — terms_accepted_at is now permanently set; would require another reset by main agent. (12) Zero JS pageerrors and zero new console errors introduced by terms-acceptance.tsx. Pre-existing warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecations, 'No route named files') are unrelated to this feature and were present in iteration_6.
critical_code_review_comments: terms-acceptance.tsx (~407 lines) is well under the 700-line target. Clean single-purpose screen.
Scroll-end detection uses a 32px padding threshold which works correctly on web — verified the marker flipped after scrolling to bottom on a 390x844 viewport (scrollHeight=2119, clientHeight=574).

TouchableOpacity disabled state is correctly wired via the `disabled={!hasScrolledToEnd || accepting}` prop AND a visual `btnDisabled` style (opacity 0.5). Pre-scroll tap fires NO network request — verified by network logger.

_layout.tsx ProtectedLayout effect (lines 36-47) cleanly handles both directions: (a) authenticated + terms not accepted + NOT on gate → router.replace('/terms-acceptance'), (b) authenticated + terms accepted + accidentally on gate → router.replace('/'). The early `return` after (a) prevents fall-through to the auth-group / index handling — correct.
Drawer.Screen 'terms-acceptance' is correctly registered with drawerItemStyle: { display: 'none' }, swipeEnabled: false, headerShown: false — verified hidden from the drawer at runtime.

handleAccept's sequencing — `await fetch(... accept-terms)` → `await refreshAuth()` → `router.replace('/')` — is race-free in practice. The protected-layout effect re-runs on the updated `user.terms_accepted_at` from refreshAuth's setUser, so by the time router.replace('/') resolves, the effect won't bounce the user back to the gate. Verified.

AuthContext.refreshAuth sets loading=true → checkAuth (which calls /api/auth/me and setUser). The effect guards `if (loading) return;` so it correctly waits for the new user payload before evaluating routing — no flicker.

Cosmetic only: the 'I Accept' phrase also appears as inline styled text inside section 1 of the terms body ('By tapping I Accept below…'). Not a bug — it's just a known thing for selector-based tests; the actual button is the LAST occurrence in DOM order (sticky action bar).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 verification points pass; decline flow not exercised by design — would require terms_accepted_at re-reset)

seed_data_creation: None created by T1. SIDE EFFECT: the admin user etheriasystems@gmail.com is now permanently accepted (terms_accepted_at stamped, terms_version='1.0' applied). To re-test the gate, main agent will need to reset terms_accepted_at=null on this user (or any other) in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRITICAL: When testing UI involving the 'I Accept' button, the text 'I Accept' appears TWICE in the DOM — once as inline styled text inside Section 1 ('By tapping I Accept below…') and once on the sticky action-bar button. Use `page.get_by_text('I Accept', exact=True).all()[-1]` (LAST occurrence), NEVER `.first` — `.first` resolves to the section-1 inline Text node and clicking it is a no-op. Same advice may apply to other gate-style screens. Also: when testing this app, ALWAYS use the public preview URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL = https://etheria-divination.preview.emergentagent.com), not localhost:3000 — localhost will fail CORS preflight on credentialed /api/auth/me calls (backend allows wildcard origin which is incompatible with credentials: include). The drawer is opened by clicking near (28, 50) on the 390x844 viewport. Logout for E2E can be simulated by `await page.evaluate(()=> localStorage.removeItem('session_token'))` then navigating to /auth/login — bypasses the modal-confirm UI flow which is finicky to script. Login flow uses math captcha 'What is A OP B = ?' supporting + and -; submit button is the LAST 'Sign In' text occurrence on the page (header label is the first).
rca_of_issue: No bug found in production code. Initial test runs (against localhost:3000 origin and with `.first` selector) appeared to show the Accept flow failing — but those were TEST ARTIFACTS: (a) localhost:3000 origin causes CORS preflight failure on the backend's credentialed /api/auth/me, so the post-accept refreshAuth would have failed in T1's environment, and (b) `.first` selector targeted the inline 'I Accept' Text inside Section 1 instead of the actual TouchableOpacity in the sticky action bar. Once both test issues were corrected (test against public preview URL + use `.last` selector for the button), the flow worked end-to-end: POST /api/auth/accept-terms 200 → refreshAuth → router.replace('/') → home renders → reload stays on home → re-login skips gate. Mitigation: documented both pitfalls in context_for_next_testing_agent so future iterations don't reproduce.
